node.statement: Define the single level-one linear map v^(2):C^2->calX by v^(2)(lambda,mu)=lambda*q_1+mu*q_2 and, for every n>=1, define only its canonical amplification v_n=id_{M_n} tensor v^(2), so v_n(A,B)=A tensor q_1+B tensor q_2. Linearity is immediate; q_i^dagger=q_i gives exact involution preservation; for the standard projection basis Pi'=(1,0), Pi''=(0,1) from def-projection-basis one has v^(2)(Pi')=q_1 and v^(2)(Pi'')=q_2; and q_1+q_2=I_X gives v^(2)(1,1)=I_X and v_n(I_n,I_n)=I_n tensor I_X exactly.
